jobs.occupation: Working Student (d/f/m) in Cabin & Cargo Architecture & Technology  (Elektroniker/in - Luftfahrttechnische Systeme)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support our day-to-day business & contribute to technology initiatives, Airbus Operations is looking for a

Working Student (d/f/m) in Cabin & Cargo Architecture & Technology

You are a full time student, looking for a working student position and want to get to know the world of a Cabin & Cargo Engineering?  Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the Architecture and Research & Technology Team as a working student (d/f/m) with approx. 18 hours a week!

- Location: Hamburg Finkenwerder
- Start: 01.12.2026
- Duration:  12 months

You will receive a collectively agreed salary of at least €18.53 per hour, depending on the job. There are also special payments such as vacation pay.

Definition working student

Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

Your location: Hamburg Finkenwerder

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Are you wondering how you actually get from university to Airbus? Your working student position is at the Finkenwerder plant and you can take the ferry from Teufelsbrück to the Airbus ferry terminal and back to the university in the morning and at noon. Alternatively, you can take the ferry to Finkenwerder and then ride your bike for about another 15 minutes to the main entrance.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and work-life balance with an 18-hour week (flexitime).
- A final thesis is possible after consultation with the department.
- Mobile working after agreement with the department.
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Project & Strategy Support: Assist with operational planning, roadmap development, and the preparation/documentation of technical workshops.
- Independent Initiatives: Lead small, dedicated mini-projects and bring your own ideas into our research portfolio.
- Demonstrator Support: Assist in organizing physical and mock-up planning and build.
- Internal Communication: Maintain internal knowledge sites (e.g., Google Sites), draft presentations, and help organize digital or team events.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Enrolled full-time student (d/f/m) in Engineering (Aerospace, Systems, Mechanical), Industrial Design, or a related field.
- Independent, creative, and comfortable taking initiative in a collaborative team environment.
- Proficient with digital collaboration tools (Google Suite / MS Office); an interest in AI applications is a plus.
- Business-fluent in English (written and spoken).

Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth.

Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

TU Darmstadt stands for excellent and relevant science. We are playing a decisive role in shaping far-reaching processes of global change-from energy transition to artificial intelligence-through outstanding scientific knowledge and innovative academic programmes. We group our cutting-edge research into three fields: Energy and Environment, Information and Intelligence, Matter and Materials. We are a university with strong ties to the Frankfurt Rhine-Main metropolitan region and a very strong international focus. We are committed to European values and European integration.

The Centre for Synthetic Biology at TU Darmstadt is a university-wide interdisciplinary research initiative bringing together biologists and biochemists with computational scientists and machine learning researchers. The PhD candidate will conduct research in AI method development for the design of novel RNA molecules with application in advanced therapeutic modalities.
Work on an interdisciplinary topic at the intersection of machine learning / AI and synthetic biology
Learn the mathematics and algorithms of state-of-the-art RNA language models
Learn the mathematics and algorithms of state-of-the-art diffusion models for generation of new RNA and protein molecules
Advance AI methods and models for the design of novel RNA molecules that get conditionally activated upon binding of specific diagnostic RNA molecules
Find novel ways to Incorporate structure and sequence information in RNA AI-models.
Build novel AI models for quantitative functional prediction of RNA designs
Work in close collaboration with experimentalists that conduct high-throughput assays for the characterization of these novel RNA molecules

An excellent university science degree (Master’s/Diploma) in computer science, electrical engineering, physics or mathematics. Master’s/Diploma degree must be completed prior to the start of employment.
Very good programming skills in python; finished larger scientific software projects
Advanced academic training / background in machine learning and AI methods.
Experience with dedicated AI methods for molecular design is a big plus.
Solid understanding of molecular biology and cell biology is a big plus.
Willingness and drive to work on an interdisciplinary project beyond traditional boundaries.

In addition, you bring:

Fluency in English for communication in an international team and for writing scientific publications

On a personal level, you distinguish yourself through:

Analytical thinking and a high degree of self-organization
Curiosity and creativity
Openness to working in an interdisciplinary and international team

Your application should include:

a cover letter explaining succinctly why you want to join this project
your CV
bachelor’s and master’s degree certificates and transcript of records
a list of publications / talks / poster contributions
contact details of 2 referees
Technical University of Darmstadt offers varied and challenging assignments, freedom to work independently, the latest technologies, good collaboration between colleagues in partnership, needs-based training opportunities and customised personnel development.

The fulfillment of the duties likewise enables the scientific qualifications of the candidate.

Development and organisation - comprehensive in-house training offers, including the opportunity for continuing education and development;
Annual leave/educational leave - 30 days annual leave (full-time employment) and 5 days educational leave;
Sustainable and mobile - eligibility to free public transport in the state of Hesse with the LandesTicket Hessen (Hesse StateTicket) in accordance with the currently valid collective agreement, in addition to opportunities to working mobile at times;
Fit and healthy - free of charge preventive medical check-ups and a wide-ranging subsidised sports programme;
Work-life balance - flexible working time models, plus BGM (Betriebliches Gesundheitsmanag...

Job Title: Client Relationship Lead

International SOS is the world’s leading medical and security services company with over 12,000 employees working in 1,000 locations in 90 countries. International SOS Government Services administers the TRICARE Overseas Program providing high-quality, accessible health care services for U.S. Military service members, family members, retirees, and other eligible beneficiaries overseas.

About the role

We’re seeking a dynamic and experienced professional to join our senior management team as a Client Relationship Lead. In this pivotal role, you will serve as the primary subject matter expert for our clients, fostering strong relationships with key stakeholders to ensure the seamless delivery of services and exceptional satisfaction with the TRICARE Overseas Program (TOP).

This role is a high-impact position and requires someone with exceptional networking abilities to influence and drive positive outcomes.

Location:

Remote working- with frequent travel across Germany

Why This Role is Exceptional:

- **Strategic Influence:** Shape the success of the TRICARE Overseas Program by building and nurturing high-level relationships with military and civilian partners.
- **Global Impact:** Work closely with Military Treatment Facilities, Bases, and Remote TOP Dedicated Network Sites worldwide to ensure the highest quality of service.
- **Flexibility and Travel:** Choose between a home-based or office-based position with the opportunity for international travel, allowing you to directly engage with stakeholders and make a difference on a global scale.

If you are a proactive, relationship-driven professional with a passion for healthcare and the military community, we’d love to hear from you!

Key responsibilities

- Lead, coordinate and drive the overall contractual KPI deliverables for Military Treatment Facilities (MTF), engagement, coordination of collaboration across all client and TOP stakeholders, securing access to care, contractual provider availability and network services, medical records collections, claims handling, beneficiary services.
- Oversight and support in the coordination of execution of all tasks that impact the MTF through in-country personnel (clinical/non-clinical) in the Area of Responsibility (AOR).
- Maintain and strengthen relationships with stakeholders by means of identifying and communicating client needs in a timely manner
- Provide ongoing support and education to above mentioned stakeholders on TOP Policy, processes, and any self-service mechanisms in place.
- Ensure the MTF or Military Units/Clinics have access to the contractually required Host Nation Network
- Develop a good understanding of internal operations by means of collaboration with cross functional teams and support the seamless execution of all contractual aspects through other departments and teams
- Represent voice of both customer and business by means of analysing and documenting client feedback thus influencing the direction of the Program.
- Develop a solid understanding of the value-added proposition offered by the TOP Program to promote maximum utilization of the various benefits available
- Identify business opportunities and share best practices amongst colleagues and stakeholders.

About you

- Significant Account Management experience and/or managing complex client programs required
- Healthcare Administration experience preferred 
- Bachelor's degree
- Excellent English language skills
- People leadership, influencing and organizational skills
- Strong analytical capabilities
- Self-motivated problem solver
- Ability to travel across Germany with own car

Benefits

- Bonus scheme
- Warm, supportive, and open company culture
- An opportunity to learn and develop in a global environment
- Remote working with some travel requirements
- Birthday holiday and option to purchase additional annual leave
- Comprehensive Benefits Package: Private Pension, Private Medical Insurance, Life Assurance and more

13,000 experts | 1,200+ locations | 90 countries | 110+ languages

Start your journey with us today. Apply now!

Institute of Physiology and Cell Biology. Starting date: as soon as possible, at the latest September 1,2026.

Area of responsibility

The Institute of Physiology and Cell Biology aims to recruit a highly motivated post-doctoral scientistto join the Cell Biology group, headed by Prof. Dr. Sjoerd van Wijk. We study how ubiquitination andautophagy control cell survival, programmed cell death, inflammation and cell differentiation inbroad pathophysiological settings, including oncology and infection. For this, human and animalpre-clinical experimental systems, including cell lines, primary cells, organoids and iPSC-derivedcells, will be integrated with cell biology with biochemistry, molecular biology and omicsapproaches, including CRISPR/Cas9 gene editing, super-resolution and confocal microscopy andmass-spectrometry. For examples of recent research, see Wächtershäuser et al, Signal TransductTarget Ther, 11(1):204; Zein et al, Autophagy, 21(5):1075-1095 and Weinelt et al, Cell Death Dis,15(1):77.

The position will be closely involved in shaping the research group, setting up the lab and planningand performing independent research at the interface of cell biology, biochemistry and molecularbiology with imaging and computational data analysis. The successful candidate will play centralroles in collaborations between different scientific and clinical research groups and in developinginnovative approaches in comparative cell biology to improve animal and human health. Theposition furthermore combines opportunities for teaching, scientific and academic qualification(Habilitation) and the development of independent research projects within the scope of the group.

Key Focus Areas:

• Independent experimental scientific research in comparative cell biology.

• Teaching and supervision of Bachelor, Master and PhD students/Habilitation.

• Coordination of lab setup and daily running.

• Contribution to the development and implementation of integrative analytical approaches forcell biology, biochemistry and molecular biology, incl. multi-omics, CRISPR/Cas-basedapproaches, imaging and bioinformatic image analysis.

• Support in the analysis of large datasets (e.g., RNA-seq, single-cell data and imaging).

• Support in the preparation of scientific publications and grant applications, for example for theGerman Research Foundation.

• Organization of scientific exchange activities, workshops and project meetings.

Recruitment requirements:

• A university degree and doctoral degree/PhD in (Molecular) Cell Biology, Biochemistry, MolecularBiology, Biology, Veterinary Medicine ("Approbation"), or a related discipline.

• Excellent written and spoken German and English language skills.

• Experience with, or strong interest in, multiscale imaging, CRISPR/Cas-based methods andprimary cell/tissue culture (organoids).

• Basic knowledge in the analysis of high-dimensional biological datasets, particularly microscopicdatasets.

• Knowledge of additional disciplines, including systems biology, gene regulation, epigenomics ormultiscale data integration, is advantageous.

Required professional knowledge and personal skills:

• Ability to communicate complex scientific concepts across disciplinary boundaries.

• Independent, structured and solution-oriented working style.

• Excellent organizational, communication and teamwork skills.

• Willingness to contribute to scientific coordination, develop independent research questions andparticipate in the preparation of publications and grant applications.

• Curious, strong analytical and conceptual thinking skills combined with the ability to developinnovative solutions.

• Flexibility and willingness to rapidly familiarize oneself with new technologies and researchareas.

What we offer:

• Special annual bonus

• Flexible working hours

• 30 days holiday

• Additional retirement arrangement: Pension Institution of the Federal Republic and the FederalStates (the company pension of the public service)

• Staff canteen with discount meal offers

• Participation in university sports at a discount

• Targeted further education and training opportunities

• Family friendliness

• Appreciative working atmosphere with contemporary management culture

The employment relationship is subject to the public sector collective agreement on the federalstates (TV-L). Severely disabled applicants will be given priority in the case of equal suitability. TheUniversity of Veterinary Medicine Hannover particularly wants to promote the professional equalityof men and women. Therefore, it strives to increase the underrepresented gender in the respective area.

Contact:

For more information, please contact Prof. Dr. Sjoerd van Wijk, Institute ofPhysiology and Cell Biology via telephone number +49 511 953-6119 or

Sjoerd.van.Wijk@tiho-hannover.de

When preparing your application, please include your CV, a motivation letter with ashort statement of your research plans and how your expertise would contribute tothe aims of our group, an overview of publications and third-party funding, as wellas the contact information of three referees. Applications should be submitted viaour online portal by 31.07.2026 at the latest.

All application documents will be destroyed after completion of the personnelselection process. Your personal data will be treated confidentially. Please see www.tiho-hannover.de/ds-bew for more information.

jobs.occupation: Product Quality Engineer (m/f/d) – Silicon Carbide (SiC) (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
jobs.description:
Job Description

About the role

As a Product Quality Engineer, you will be expected to step into the game and display your excellent quality mindset to help drive our innovations beyond industry standards

What you will do

- Represent the Quality Management within the development team
- Correlate the SiC failure mechanisms with reliability measures to be implemented into the product quality
- Support the definition and execution of qualification activities for SiC product developments
- Contribute to the implementation of quality procedures and quality standards (Nexperia, JEDEC, AEC, and customer-specific) within projects
- Support the development, review, and verification of final test specifications
- Promote quality awareness and best practices to internal and external stakeholders
- Support customer requests and complaints handling activities
- Contribute to the identification and resolution of quality gaps in the product creation process
- Support the definition of qualification requirements and qualification of manufacturing processes
- Maintain documentation and handle data in analysis tools for Reliability, Yield, FMEA, Customer Requests, and related activities
- Perform analyses to identify root causes of yield loss or production issues and support the implementation of containment and corrective actions
- Prepare initial input for PCNs, support review and release activities, and contribute to follow-up actions

What you will need

- Master’s degree in Electronics Engineering, Physics or a similar discipline
- Experience in a similar position is desirable and experienced in wafer fab and assembly processes preferred
- Knowledge in semiconductor physics as well as in semiconductor applications in the SiC domain
- First knowledge of international quality standards and policies e.g. AEC-Q101, AQG 324
- Familiar with measurement methods and equipment as well as device testing environments
- Familiar with standard software tools (e.g. Office), problem solving techniques
- High-quality mindset and ability to work under pressure
- Fluent spoken and written English skills
- Strong know how in statistical data analysis
- Good communication and presentation skills
- Good team player and willingness to travel
- Assertiveness and demonstrated influencing skills
- Open mindset, which welcomes changes and views problems as opportunities

About the role

At Nexperia, we build around 100 billion essential semiconductors a year. These microchips are a crucial part of cars, mobiles, watches, white goods, mobility solutions – you name it. It is more than likely that all your gadgets carry one or more Nexperia chips.

We are headquartered in the Netherlands and have Frontend and Backend production sites across the globe.

Our Procurement is organized in a global matrix structure. We are an international team equipped with many years of solid industry knowledge and you will find it easy to integrate in our team if you identify with our working principles: take ownership, drive with perseverance, be efficient, and enjoy what you do.

We are searching for a Global Sourcing Manager for our Global NPR Team.

In this role you will

- be accountable for selected global NPR (non-product related) subcategories, such as People & Professional, IT, Utilities Management and others purchased for specific or all our Nexperia sites.
- develop robust and long-term sourcing strategies and roadmaps for the categories you own based on key suppliers, market position, technology capabilities, pricing development, and risk mitigation – in alignment with sr. leadership and key stakeholders.
- be building and nurturing long-term supplier partnerships focusing on the 4-Buy Principle (Buy Right, Buy Low, Buy Little, Buy On-Time) and Nexperia procurement processes, achieving best total cost of ownership for Nexperia.
- manage supplier performance for best-in-class supply base.
- drive synergy spends to consolidate count of suppliers and drive costs down on e.g. consumables.
- actively involving yourself in system and process related improvement projects.
- drive and support stakeholder management on procurement processes.
- give support to team colleagues as well as development to the team.

Ideally you have

- a commercial degree and >10 years of experience in semiconductor or similar industries.
- proven track record of sourcing roles.
- excellent English speaking and communication skills amongst various groups of stakeholders, also across borders (Tier 1+2 sites).
- proven negotiation and analytical skills.
- capability of thinking out of the box while continuously challenging the status quo.

jobs.description:
Join D.Med Consulting GmbH – Pioneering Medical Device Technologies

D.Med Consulting GmbH, headquartered in Hamburg, Germany, is a joint venture between Fresenius Medical Care AG (51%) and the D.Med Healthcare Group (49%). Founded in 2011, we are a leading provider of research, development and consulting services specializing in extracorporeal therapies. The collaboration with Fresenius Medical Care, the world leader in renal care, and the D.Med Healthcare Group, a renowned provider in nephrology, cardiology, and internal medicine, allows us to offer a comprehensive range of services from concept to implementation. Join our team of dedicated professionals and contribute to groundbreaking advancements in medical device technology. Join us and experience a true partnership in innovation – working hand-in-hand to achieve our customer goals.

For our office in Hamburg and at the earliest possible starting date we are looking for a

Quality and Regulatory Affairs Manager Medical Devices (m/f/d)

Your responsibilities:

- Regulatory Analysis: Conducting regulatory GAP analyses and overseeing the interpretation and integration of applicable global regulatory requirements for medical devices into internal processes
- Technical Documentation: Creating, reviewing, and maintaining high-quality technical documentation in compliance with MDR, IVDR, and other relevant standards
- Market Access & Registration: Developing and managing market access and registration strategies for active and non-active medical devices, including Software as a Medical Device (SaMD), with focus on regulatory compliance
-  Quality Management Systems (QMS): Establishing, maintaining, and continuously improving Quality Management Systems (QMS) according to ISO 13485, including the preparation and maintenance of related documentation
- Regulatory Developments: Continuously monitoring and evaluating changes in global regulatory landscapes and implementing necessary updates to QMS and technical documentation
- Risk Management: Leading the identification, analysis, evaluation, and documentation of product-related risks for medical devices in accordance with ISO 14971, with a strong focus on quality and compliance
-  Safety Assessment: Assessing the safety relevance of hazards in close collaboration with cross-functional teams and ensuring alignment with regulatory and quality requirements

Your profile:

- Degree in medical technology, engineering, natural sciences, or a related technical field
- Several years of hands-on experience in quality management and/or regulatory affairs within the medical device industry
- In-depth understanding of MDR, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, IEC 62304, and risk and safety analysis methodologies (FMEA, FTA)
- Proven knowledge in product development and risk management, especially with systems combining hardware, software, and mechanics
- Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively in interdisciplinary teams
- Structured, independent, and goal-oriented working style
- Strong analytical thinking and sound decision-making capabilities
- Fluent in English; proficiency in German is a plus

What we offer: 

- A diversified and challenging environment combined with a high degree of freedom for the implementation of innovative ideas
- A permanent employment contract with performance-related pay at an international and promising employer
- A modern workplace in spacious and bright offices in the heart of Hamburg with a view of the River Elbe
- A supportive working atmosphere in a dynamic team with short decision paths
- An individually tailored “on the job” training and professional development opportunities
- Personal added values such as a company pension scheme, team events, employee discounts, bike leasing and much more

Do you see this job offer as a personal challenge and do you want to make a difference? Then share your application, including your salary expectations and your earliest possible starting date, with us by clicking on “Apply for job”.

We are looking forward to meeting you!

D.Med Consulting GmbH | Bernhard-Nocht-Str. 99 | 20359 Hamburg | +49 211 650 415 14

jobs.occupation: Strategy Manager (m/f/d) in the CEO Office (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule) - Unternehmensführung, Management)
jobs.description:
What do we rely on at ENCAVIS? The sun. The wind. And on you.
Welcome to Encavis! Our world is all about the power of the sun, the wind and the more than 400 people across our group who are working together to shape the energy system of the future in order to ensure a sustainable energy supply for future generations.
ENCAVIS Management GmbH & Co. KG is the holding company of ENCAVIS GmbH , one of Europe's leading electricity producers from renewable energies. We operate a broadly diversified portfolio of over 330 onshore wind farms, ground-mounted solar plants and battery storage facilities in 13 European countries with an installed capacity of more than 5 GW. And best of all, we are continuing to grow! Our subsidiaries, Stern Energy SpA , which operates throughout Europe as a specialist in technical services for photovoltaic systems, and Encavis Portfolio Management GmbH, which specialises in supporting institutional investors, complement our portfolio.

What does this mean for you? The opportunity to make a difference, to shape and change things. As part of a multinational team that enjoys helping to make the energy transition a success.
The CEO Office sits at the center of Encavis’ strategic development and transformation agenda. Acting as both a strategic PMO and trusted sparring partner to the CEO and C-Suite, the team drives the execution of the company’s most critical initiatives, ensures alignment across functions, and supports key decision-making processes. From shaping corporate strategy and monitoring performance to leading cross-functional transformation programs and preparing board-level materials, the CEO Office helps translate long-term ambitions into tangible business outcomes and serves as a catalyst for the next phase of Encavis’ growth. Given the increasing complexity and scale of our business, we are looking for an experienced Strategy Manager to join us and help shape the next chapter of Encavis’ growth.
There are plenty of reasons to join Encavis – but what truly sets this opportunity apart is the chance to take on significant responsibility and gain meaningful exposure from day one. You will work directly with senior leadership, with broad exposure across investing, investor solutions, platform strategy, and business building, while contributing within an established and growing platform. Combined with competitive compensation and performance-linked upside, this is a high-impact role offering both visibility and influence from the outset.
Your sunny outlook:
Strategy & Executive Support
• Partner with the CEO and Chief of Staff on strategic priorities and decision-making
• Develop business cases and strategic recommendations for executive leadership

Performance & Market Intelligence
• Analyze market developments, competitors and performance indicators
• Translate data into actionable management insights

Project & Transformation Management
• Lead strategic initiatives and cross-functional transformation programs
• Track execution progress and drive accountability across functions

Board & Stakeholder Management
• Prepare executive, board and investor-facing materials
